summary: Build practical skills in humanitarian sourcing, pre-positioning and risk planning. Explore the course and strengthen supply continuity.
lede: Humanitarian supply chain resilience training helps procurement, logistics and programme professionals plan essential-goods sourcing and continuity. They practise ISO 31000 risk and scenario analysis, responsible sourcing using ISO 20400 guidance, supplier segmentation, pre-positioning and safety-stock decisions. Exercises use Excel scenarios and produce a risk register, sourcing matrix, inventory decision sheet and resilience action plan.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who make or oversee procurement, logistics, and supply continuity decisions for humanitarian response and public programmes.
prerequisites: Prerequisites: Working familiarity with procurement, logistics, humanitarian operations, or public programme delivery is recommended. No coding or programming is required. Excel access is useful for the spreadsheet-based exercises; AI-assisted demand sensing and inventory automation are introduced at conceptual level rather than implemented.
